scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run quality:frontend && npm run quality:backend && npm run test
scripts.format:check: frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --check package.json .prettierrc docs .github server/src server/package.json server/tsconfig.json server/prisma.config.ts
scripts.quality:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run check && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.quality:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
